type="text/css" data-vite-dev-id="D:/moodle/_qoder_ord0344_S1/frontend/src/features/simulation/SimulationPanel.css">/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * The stage's floating widget (the traveller's own words: "点一下会展开，里面有
 * 各种功能，但是别把屏幕挡住").
 *
 * `.cn-sim-float` is portalled to `document.body`, so these `position: fixed`
 * boxes are anchored to the viewport instead of to a transformed ancestor --
 * the last attempt that stayed inside the page parked the sheet at top -374.
 *
 * The bottom offsets are measured, not derived: on a phone the app reserves
 * `124px + safe-area` of bottom band for the fixed nav (`--cn-nav-h` 80px plus
 * the safe area) and the Copilot pill resting on top of it
 * (`styles.css:405` `bottom: 72px`, `.cn-copilot-edge` `min-height: 50px`), so
 * anything parked below ~122px is on top of somebody else's control. Desktop's
 * pill sits at `bottom: 22px` with `min-height: 56px`. Both numbers get a gate:
 * `sim-stage-actions-are-reachable-and-never-in-the-nav-band` asserts the ball
 * and the open window overlap neither overlay, and that every row is still
 * centre-hittable with the window open.
 * -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
:root {
  --cn-sim-float-clearance: calc(22px + 56px + 12px);
}
.cn-sim-float {
  position: fixed;
  right: 12px;
  bottom: var(--cn-sim-float-clearance);
  z-index: 30;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-end;
  gap: var(--cn-s-8, 8px);
}
.cn-sim-ball {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 48px;
  height: 48px;
  padding: 0;
  border: 1px solid var(--cn-hairline, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.16));
  border-radius: 50%;
  color: var(--v8-ink);
  background: var(--cn-surface);
  /* Translucent by request, but not see-through enough to lose its own edge:
     the ring keeps the ball readable over both a photo-free map and a dark card. */
  opacity: 0.94;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 26px rgba(20, 35, 59, 0.18);
  cursor: pointer;
}
.cn-sim-ball-dot {
  width: 12px;
  height: 12px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #62b58a;
}
/* Two colours, one truth: the dot only answers "is there a scenario on stage".
   Everything else -- which clock, which deployment -- is text, in the window and
   in the ball's accessible name, never in a colour a traveller has to decode. */
.cn-sim-ball-dot[data-state="STAGE_LIVE"] {
  background: #62b58a;
}
.cn-sim-ball-dot[data-state="CHECKING"],
.cn-sim-ball-dot[data-state="UNREADABLE"],
.cn-sim-ball-dot[data-state="NO_STAGE"] {
  background: #8b93a1;
}
/* `v8-page` on this element is not decoration: the dark content-surface group (`design-tokens.css:534`)
   and the AA outline border (`:666`) are both keyed to that scope, and portalling the widget out of it
   silently gave back white buttons on a dark panel and a 1.36:1 border. Re-declaring each override here
   would leave the next portalled surface with the same bug, so the window declares itself a page
   surface and these rules bind one step stronger to keep the card's own fill. */
.v8-page.cn-sim-pop {
  /* Measured, not assumed: without this the box rendered 392px inside a 390px viewport, because the
     padding and border were added outside the declared width. The budget is about what the traveller
     sees, so it applies to the border box. */
  box-sizing: border-box;
  /* The ink is stated because the widget hangs off `document.body`, outside the subtree that used to
     hand it down: with the inheritance gone the rows measured `rgb(217,221,234)` on white, 1.36:1. */
  color: var(--v8-ink);
  background: var(--cn-surface);
  width: min(360px, calc(100vw - 24px));
  max-height: 60vh;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--cn-s-8, 8px);
  padding: var(--cn-s-12);
  border: 1px solid var(--cn-hairline, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.16));
  border-radius: var(--cn-r-card, 14px);
  background: var(--cn-surface);
  box-shadow: 0 18px 46px rgba(20, 35, 59, 0.24);
}
/* The declaration the stage owes the traveller, in full ink: this is the honest
   sentence, not a caption about it. */
.cn-sim-pop-decl {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--v8-ink);
  font-size: var(--cn-fs-caption);
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.45;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
/* The scroll lives on the panel itself, not on a wrapper around it.  Two probes of this widget
   (mine and the Commander's) each spent a round arguing about a different node, because the
   scroller was an inner box while everyone measured `[data-testid="sim-panel"]` -- whose own
   `maxScroll` is then always 0, no matter whether the window scrolls.  One scrollable element, and
   it is the one the testid names: the wrapper only passes the bounded height down the flex chain. */
.cn-sim-pop-body {
  min-height: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}
.cn-sim-pop-body > .cn-sim {
  min-height: 0;
  overflow-y: auto;
  overscroll-behavior: contain;
}

/* Nothing hides the closed panel, because there is nothing to hide: the window is not in the
   document while closed, so no clipped row can keep a rect inside the nav band -- the failure that
   killed the earlier `max-height + overflow` sheet. On a phone the reserved band is taller, because
   the nav and the Copilot pill both live there. */
@media (max-width: 680px) {
  :root {
    --cn-sim-float-clearance: calc(124px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px) + 12px);
  }
  .v8-page.cn-sim-pop {
    width: calc(100vw - 24px);
  }
}

/*
 * ORD-0059 (b) -- the Simulation entry's own sheet.
 *
 * Tokens only, and full ink for every sentence that carries meaning: this surface explains
 * refusals, and a refusal written in a grey that fails contrast in one theme is a refusal the
 * traveller did not receive.  The dark audit measures it at 390px in both themes, so nothing
 * here may depend on a colour that only works on one of them.
 */
.cn-sim {
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--cn-s-12);
  margin: 0;
  padding: var(--cn-s-12);
  border: 1px solid var(--cn-hairline, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.16));
  border-radius: var(--cn-r-card, 14px);
  background: var(--cn-surface);
  color: var(--v8-ink);
  min-width: 0;
}
.cn-sim *,
.cn-sim *::before,
.cn-sim *::after {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.cn-sim-banner {
  margin: 0;
  padding: var(--cn-s-8) var(--cn-s-12);
  border-left: 3px solid var(--cn-accent-text);
  border-radius: var(--cn-r-control);
  background: var(--cn-secondary);
  color: var(--v8-ink);
  font-size: var(--cn-fs-body);
  font-weight: 650;
  line-height: 1.4;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.cn-sim-retry {
  justify-self: start;
}
/* The window has no summary to click shut, so the way back out lives in here. */
.cn-sim-close {
  justify-self: end;
}
/* Diagnostic, not decoration: smaller than the banner, but full ink -- a flag that only reads in
   one theme is a flag nobody can check on a phone. */
.cn-sim-diag {
  margin: calc(-1 * var(--cn-s-4, 4px)) 0 0;
  color: var(--v8-ink);
  font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace;
  font-size: var(--cn-fs-caption);
  line-height: 1.4;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.cn-sim-facts {
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--cn-s-4, 4px);
  margin: 0;
}
.cn-sim-facts > div {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: var(--cn-s-8);
  justify-content: space-between;
  min-width: 0;
}
.cn-sim-facts dt {
  color: var(--v8-ink);
  font-size: var(--cn-fs-caption);
  font-weight: 700;
}
.cn-sim-facts dd {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--v8-ink);
  font-size: var(--cn-fs-caption);
  text-align: right;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.cn-sim-mismatch {
  margin: 0;
  padding: var(--cn-s-8) var(--cn-s-12);
  border-left: 3px solid var(--cn-warning);
  border-radius: var(--cn-r-control);
  background: var(--cn-secondary);
  color: var(--v8-ink);
  font-size: var(--cn-fs-caption);
  line-height: 1.45;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.cn-sim-actions {
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--cn-s-8);
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
}
.cn-sim-row {
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--cn-s-4, 4px);
  min-width: 0;
}
.cn-sim-button {
  justify-self: stretch;
  text-align: left;
  min-width: 0;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
/* Same wash as a real disabled control, so "cannot run" is visible and not only spoken. */
.cn-sim-button[aria-disabled="true"] {
  opacity: 0.5;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}
.cn-sim-reason {
  margin: 0;
  padding-left: var(--cn-s-12);
  border-left: 2px solid var(--cn-accent-text);
  color: var(--v8-ink);
  font-size: var(--cn-fs-caption);
  line-height: 1.45;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.cn-sim-outcome,
.cn-sim-refusal {
  margin: 0;
  padding: var(--cn-s-8) var(--cn-s-12);
  border-radius: var(--cn-r-control);
  background: var(--cn-secondary);
  color: var(--v8-ink);
  font-size: var(--cn-fs-body);
  line-height: 1.45;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.cn-sim-refusal {
  border-left: 3px solid var(--cn-danger);
}
.cn-sim-outcome-note {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--v8-ink);
  font-size: var(--cn-fs-caption);
  line-height: 1.45;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

/* The 44px floor is a mobile rule only; desktop keeps the compact density it was audited with. */
@media (max-width: 680px) {
  .cn-sim-actions button {
    min-height: var(--cn-touch-min);
  }
  /* Nothing here reserves a band any more. The widget is portalled out of the page and parked above
     the nav + Copilot band by `--cn-sim-float-clearance` (measured, see the top of this file), and
     its rows scroll inside `.cn-sim-pop-body`, so no page scroll position can push a row under
     the nav -- which is what the old `scroll-margin` on `.cn-sim-entry` was trying, and failing, to
     do. Keeping the `sim-stage-actions-*` gate on the ball and window is what holds this now. */
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .cn-sim * {
    animation: none !important;
    transition: none !important;
  }
}

/* V18 traveler-first Copilot dock and state-driven motion. */
:root {
  --cn-motion-instant: 90ms;
  --cn-motion-fast: 160ms;
  --cn-motion-base: 220ms;
  --cn-motion-slow: 420ms;
  --cn-motion-map: 650ms;
  --cn-ease-standard: cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);
  --cn-ease-enter: cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);
}
::view-transition-old(root) { animation: cn-route-out var(--cn-motion-fast) ease both; }
::view-transition-new(root) { animation: cn-route-in var(--cn-motion-base) var(--cn-ease-enter) both; }
@keyframes cn-route-out { to { opacity: 0; } }
@keyframes cn-route-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(8px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }
.cn-copilot-dock { position: fixed; right: 22px; bottom: 22px; z-index: 25; width: min(390px, calc(100vw - 44px)); }

.v8-alert-pop .v8-kicker { margin: 0 0 8px; }
.v8-alert-pop article { display: grid; gap: 3px; padding: 10px 0; border-top: 1px solid #edf0f4; }
.v8-alert-pop article b { font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.v8-alert-pop article span { color: #5d6878; font-size: 11px; }
.v8-alert-pop article small { color: #9aa4b3; font-size: 10px; }
.v8-alert-pop .v8-muted { margin: 6px 0 0; color: #5d6878; font-size: 11px; }
.v15-copilot-suggestions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 7px; margin-top: 12px; }.v15-copilot-suggestions .v8-outline-button { min-height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; color: #c5d2e8; border-color: #526b94; background: transparent; font-size: 10px; }.v15-copilot-history { display: grid; gap: 10px; margin-top: 15px; }.v15-copilot-message { max-width: 820px; padding: 16px 18px; border: 1px solid #dce2eb; border-radius: 11px; background: #fff; }.v15-copilot-message.user { margin-left: auto; border-color: #d7dcff; background: #f6f7ff; }.v15-copilot-message p { margin: 7px 0 0; color: #536176; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.55; }.v15-copilot-evidence { display: grid; gap: 10px; margin-top: 14px; }.v15-copilot-badges { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 7px; align-items: center; }.v15-what-if { padding: 13px; border: 1px solid #e5dfff; border-radius: 9px; background: #faf9ff; }.v15-what-if-head, .v15-copilot-action { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; }.v15-what-if-head b { font-size: 12px; }.v15-what-if-head span { padding: 4px 6px; border-radius: 4px; color: #6f56b6; background: #eee9ff; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .07em; text-transform: uppercase; }.v15-what-if-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 8px; margin: 12px 0 9px; }.v15-what-if-grid div { display: grid; gap: 4px; padding: 9px; border: 1px solid #ebe8f7; border-radius: 6px; background: #fff; }.v15-what-if-grid span, .v15-copilot-action > span, .v15-what-if small { color: #8d96a6; font-size: 9px; }.v15-what-if-grid b { color: var(--v8-ink); font-size: 11px; }.v15-copilot-action { padding-top: 3px; }.v15-copilot-action .v8-secondary { min-height: 33px; padding: 0 10px; font-size: 10px; }

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *
 * Create-trip (JourneyTrialSetup) — three-step traveller flow.
 * Corrections §4/§5: sticky visible CTA, inferred region, advanced
 * settings tucked away, values preserved when going back.
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
.trial-steps {
  display: flex;
  gap: 6px;
  list-style: none;
  margin: 12px 0 16px;
  padding: 0;
}
.trial-steps li {
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  font-size: 11px;
  opacity: 0.55;
  min-width: 0;
}
.trial-steps li span:last-child {
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.trial-steps li.active,
.trial-steps li.done {
  opacity: 1;
}
.trial-step-dot {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  border: 1px solid currentColor;
  font-size: 11px;
}
.trial-steps li.active .trial-step-dot {
  background: var(--v8-accent, #0f766e);
  border-color: var(--v8-accent, #0f766e);
  color: #fff;
}
.trial-steps li.done .trial-step-dot {
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--v8-accent, #0f766e);
  border-color: var(--v8-accent, #0f766e);
}

.trial-card {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
}
.trial-field {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
  font-size: 12px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.trial-field input,
.trial-field textarea {
  width: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}
.trial-row {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 10px;
}
.trial-row > .trial-field {
  flex: 1 1 140px;
}
.trial-inferred {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 12px;
  opacity: 0.8;
}
.trial-advanced summary {
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 12px;
  opacity: 0.75;
}
.trial-fieldset {
  border: 0;
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 12px;
}
.trial-fieldset legend {
  padding: 0 0 6px;
  font-size: 12px;
  opacity: 0.8;
}
.trial-chips {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 6px;
}
.trial-chips button {
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 6px 12px;
  font-size: 12px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(127, 127, 127, 0.45);
  background: transparent;
  color: inherit;
}
.trial-chips button.active {
  background: var(--v8-accent, #0f766e);
  border-color: var(--v8-accent, #0f766e);
  color: #fff;
}
.trial-review {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 13px;
}
.trial-review > div {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
}
.trial-review dt {
  opacity: 0.65;
}
.trial-review dd {
  margin: 0;
  text-align: right;
  word-break: break-word;
}
.trial-back-link {
  background: none;
  border: 0;
  padding: 4px 0;
  font-size: 12px;
  text-decoration: underline;
  opacity: 0.75;
  color: inherit;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.trial-secondary {
  display: flex;
  gap: 16px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin-top: 12px;
}

/* ORD-0135 ③: the missing-field jump is a text link inside the sentence, so the route to a field
   costs no line of height.  Measured: giving it its own 24px box grew the hint by 58px, and the
   wizard's sticky CTA then centred straight into the fixed stage ball (38px overlap at 360x800, and
   the mobile gate's 44px chrome-coverage rule went red).  Inline targets inside a sentence are the
   WGAC 2.5.8 inline exception -- the sentence line is the tap target -- and it stays a real button,
   so it remains keyboard-reachable. */
/* ORD-0350: the confirmation rows' own exits share this rule on purpose -- a boxy button per row
   would grow the review card, and the measured sticky-CTA/stage-ball collision above applies. */
.trial-missing-jump, .trial-review-edit {
  display: inline;
  min-height: 0;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
  color: var(--v8-accent, #0f766e);
  background: transparent;
  cursor: pointer;
  font: inherit;
  font-weight: 750;
  line-height: inherit;
  vertical-align: baseline;
  text-decoration: underline;
}

/* ORD-0193: the destination-preparation flow.  The verdict, the missing categories and the job's
   own record all come from the server, so these rules only have to keep them readable on a phone --
   no bar, because the server publishes no percentage to fill one with. */
.prep-form { display: grid; gap: var(--cn-s-12); margin-top: var(--cn-s-16); }
.prep-form label { display: grid; gap: 7px; color: var(--v8-ink); font-size: var(--cn-fs-body); font-weight: 750; }
.prep-form input { min-width: 0; padding: var(--cn-s-12); border: 1px solid var(--cn-control-border); border-radius: var(--cn-r-control); color: var(--v8-ink); background: var(--v8-panel); font: inherit; }
.prep-verdict, .prep-job { display: grid; gap: var(--cn-s-8); margin-top: var(--cn-s-16); padding: var(--cn-s-16); border: 1px solid var(--cn-hairline); border-radius: var(--cn-r-card); background: var(--v8-panel); }
.prep-verdict h2, .prep-job h3 { margin: 0; color: var(--v8-ink); font-size: var(--cn-fs-title); }
.prep-verdict p, .prep-job p { margin: 0; color: var(--v8-ink); font-size: var(--cn-fs-body); line-height: 1.5; }
.prep-coverage, .prep-providers, .prep-candidates ul { display: grid; gap: 4px; margin: 0; padding-left: 18px; color: var(--v8-muted); font-size: var(--cn-fs-caption); overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.prep-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: var(--cn-s-8); margin-top: var(--cn-s-8); }
.prep-server { color: var(--v8-muted); font-size: var(--cn-fs-caption); overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
/* A job that has settled says so in words and in its border, so the state does not depend on colour
   alone (the same rule the dark-contrast pass settled on). */
.prep-job.running { border-style: dashed; }
.prep-job.terminal { border-width: 2px; }
@media (max-width: 680px) {
  .prep-actions { display: grid; }
  .prep-actions button { min-height: var(--cn-touch-min); width: 100%; }
}

/* ORD-0208 3: the marker that separates an inferred default from a typed answer.  Words, not
   colour, carry the distinction -- the same rule the dark-contrast pass settled on. */
.trial-default-mark { color: var(--v8-muted, #8994a3); font-size: var(--cn-fs-caption, 11px); font-weight: 500; }

/* The primary action must never be invisible or buried.  ORD-0338 (甲) settles *how*: the band is
   the onboarding pane's second grid row (design-tokens.css `.cn-onboarding`), not an overlay that
   floats over the scrolling content.  So it no longer needs `position: sticky`, no longer needs a
   gradient to fake a soft edge over what it covered, and the content no longer needs padding to
   hide from it.  The stage ball stays clear of it by its own `--cn-sim-float-clearance`
   (SimulationPanel.css:20/122), which measured 136px+safe on a phone against a band of 68px. */
.trial-sticky-cta {
  display: flex;
  gap: 10px;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  padding: 12px var(--cn-onboarding-inset) calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
  background: var(--v8-canvas);
}
/* ORD-0261 used to reserve 76px (desktop) and 76px + stage clearance (phone) of `padding-bottom`
   on `.trial-steps`, i.e. a blank band between the step row and the card, purely to keep content
   out of the sticky bar's paint-over range.  Deleted with the overlay: the bar cannot cover
   content any more, so the reserve has nothing left to do. */
.trial-sticky-cta .v8-primary-button {
  min-width: 140px;
}
.v8-primary-button {
  background: var(--v8-accent, #0f766e);
  color: #fff;
  border: 1px solid var(--v8-accent, #0f766e);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 10px 16px;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.v8-primary-button:disabled {
  opacity: 0.45;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}
/* ORD-0066 (甲): the wizard's blocked "Next" is aria-disabled so a keyboard and screen-reader
   traveller can reach it and hear why it will not advance.  It must still *look* like a control
   that cannot advance -- same wash as :disabled, plus the focus ring the browser now gives it. */
.v8-primary-button[aria-disabled="true"],
.v8-outline-button[aria-disabled="true"] {
  opacity: 0.45;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}
.v8-outline-button:disabled {
  opacity: 0.45;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}

/* Map truth: an explicit no-location state instead of another city's map. */
.v8-map-empty {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  min-height: 260px;
  padding: 24px 18px;
  text-align: center;
}
.v8-map-empty-body {
  max-width: 340px;
  line-height: 1.55;
}
.v8-map-empty-body b {
  display: block;
  font-size: 15px;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}
.v8-map-empty-body p {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 13px;
  opacity: 0.78;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *
 * Copilot footprint on phones.
 * The dock must sit above the bottom navigation and must never take
 * most of the screen; the panel scrolls internally instead.
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
@media (max-width: 680px) {
  .cn-copilot-dock {
    right: 10px;
    left: 10px;
    bottom: calc(84px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
    width: auto;
  }
  .cn-copilot-edge {
    min-height: 48px;
    padding: 0 14px;
    border-radius: 13px;
    font-size: 11px;
  }
  .cn-copilot-panel {
    max-height: min(62vh, 460px);
    padding: 14px;
    overflow: auto;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
  }
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *
 * "AI 帮我规划" planning sheet.
 *
 * This block used to be light-only by construction: the sheet hardcoded #f9fbfd,
 * never declared a foreground, and its textarea / example chips / close button all
 * said `color: inherit`.  Under a dark system theme body hands back --cn-ink (#f5f5f7),
 * so near-white text landed on a near-white panel — the "一片白，字看不清" report.
 * The fix is not a fourth !important patch section: every declaration below now names a
 * token that already flips, so the sheet is theme-correct by construction and cannot
 * drift again when a new surface is added to it.
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
.plan-ai-sheet {
  /* The budget is about what the traveller sees, so it applies to the border box: measured without
     this, a `--vv-height` of 300px produced a 333px sheet -- the 16px padding top and bottom plus the
     1px border landed *outside* the declared height, which is the same 33px of footer sitting below
     the visible viewport that this whole order is about. */
  box-sizing: border-box;
  width: min(520px, 100%);
  /* ORD-0134 ①: bounded by the *visible* viewport, with `100dvh` for a browser that never
     publishes --vv-height.  `92vh` measured the layout box, so a keyboard or a toolbar could leave
     the sheet's own action row painted below what the traveller can see -- and because the sheet
     scrolled itself, the clipped box was also the scrollport: scrolling could not rescue the footer.
     Measured at 360x640: `plan-ai-submit` centre y=790, `elementFromPoint` -> nothing. */
  max-height: min(92vh, calc(var(--vv-height, 100dvh) - var(--vv-offset, 0px)));
  /* One scroll region, and it is not the sheet: header and footer stay pinned, the middle moves. */
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  overflow: hidden;
  gap: var(--cn-s-12);
  padding: var(--cn-s-16) var(--cn-s-16) calc(var(--cn-s-16) + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
  border-radius: var(--cn-r-sheet) var(--cn-r-sheet) 0 0;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--cn-hairline);
  background: var(--cn-surface);
  color: var(--v8-ink);
  box-shadow: var(--cn-shadow-raised);
}
/* The pinned ends and the single moving middle: the footer of an overlay that owns two buttons must
   never be something the traveller has to scroll past -- or scroll to -- to press. */
.plan-ai-head,
.plan-ai-actions {
  flex: none;
}
.plan-ai-scroll {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-height: 0;
  overflow-y: auto;
  overscroll-behavior: contain;
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--cn-s-12);
}
.plan-ai-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--cn-s-12);
}
.plan-ai-head b {
  font-size: var(--cn-fs-secondary);
}
/* opacity used to do the de-emphasis here (0.72), which lowers the *measured* contrast
   ratio along with the visual weight. --v8-muted is the AA-checked subordinate ink. */
.plan-ai-head small {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 4px;
  font-size: var(--cn-fs-body);
  color: var(--v8-muted);
  line-height: 1.45;
}
.plan-ai-close {
  min-height: 30px;
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  font-size: 22px;
  line-height: 1;
  cursor: pointer;
  color: var(--v8-muted);
  padding: 0 4px;
}
.plan-ai-field textarea {
  width: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  min-height: 34px;
  font: inherit;
  font-size: var(--cn-fs-body);
  padding: var(--cn-s-12);
  border-radius: var(--cn-r-control);
  border: 1px solid var(--cn-control-border);
  background: var(--cn-surface);
  color: var(--v8-ink);
  resize: vertical;
}
.plan-ai-field textarea::placeholder { color: var(--cn-ink-tertiary); }
/* ORD-0250: a refused press has to leave a reason a traveller can read, so it takes the same token
   treatment as the result block -- same surface, hairline and semantic left rule, no new fill and no
   colour carrying the meaning by itself. */
.plan-ai-field-hint {
  margin: 8px 0 0;
  padding: var(--cn-s-12);
  border: 1px solid var(--cn-hairline);
  border-left: 3px solid var(--cn-warning);
  border-radius: var(--cn-r-control);
  background: var(--cn-secondary);
  color: var(--v8-ink);
  font-size: var(--cn-fs-body);
  line-height: 1.5;
}
.plan-ai-examples {
  display: flex;
  gap: 6px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.plan-ai-examples button {
  min-height: 30px;
  border-radius: var(--cn-r-pill);
  padding: 5px 10px;
  font-size: var(--cn-fs-body);
  border: 1px solid var(--cn-hairline);
  background: var(--cn-secondary);
  color: var(--v8-ink);
  cursor: pointer;
}
.plan-ai-steps {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  display: grid;
  gap: 6px;
  font-size: var(--cn-fs-body);
  /* Was --v8-muted, which styles.css overrides theme-blind: pending rows were small
     grey text nobody could read.  The ○/●/✓ marker and the weight carry the state now,
     so the words do not have to. */
  color: var(--v8-ink);
}
.plan-ai-steps li {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--cn-s-8);
}
.plan-ai-steps li.active {
  font-weight: 600;
}
.plan-ai-steps li.active,
.plan-ai-steps li.done {
  color: var(--v8-ink);
}
.plan-ai-dot {
  width: 16px;
  text-align: center;
}
/* ORD-0038 — the sheet says only what it can prove: the phase it is genuinely in,
   the seconds that really elapsed, and the fact that the backend sends nothing between
   "sent" and "answered". */
.plan-ai-preflight {
  margin: 0;
  padding: var(--cn-s-8) var(--cn-s-12);
  border: 1px solid var(--cn-hairline);
  border-left: 3px solid var(--cn-ink-tertiary);
  border-radius: var(--cn-r-control);
  background: var(--cn-secondary);
  color: var(--v8-ink);
  font-size: var(--cn-fs-body);
  line-height: 1.45;
}
.plan-ai-preflight.ready { border-left-color: var(--cn-success); }
.plan-ai-preflight.unconfigured { border-left-color: var(--cn-warning); }
.plan-ai-live {
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--cn-s-8);
  padding: var(--cn-s-12);
  border: 1px solid var(--cn-hairline);
  border-radius: var(--cn-r-control);
  background: var(--cn-secondary);
}
.plan-ai-live-line {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--cn-s-8);
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--v8-ink);
  font-size: var(--cn-fs-body);
  font-weight: 600;
}
.plan-ai-live-note {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--v8-ink);
  font-size: var(--cn-fs-body);
  line-height: 1.45;
}
.plan-ai-pulse {
  flex: none;
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--cn-accent);
}
@keyframes plan-ai-pulse {
  0%,
  100% {
    opacity: 0.35;
  }
  50% {
    opacity: 1;
  }
}
/* A waiting indicator may move, but never to a traveller who asked us not to. */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
  .plan-ai-pulse {
    animation: plan-ai-pulse 1.6s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
}

/* ORD-0047 — the create flow's wait.  Same rule as the sheet above: name the stage, count
   the seconds, and never animate for someone who asked not to. */
.trial-wait {
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--cn-s-8);
  margin: 0 0 var(--cn-s-12);
  padding: var(--cn-s-12);
  border: 1px solid var(--cn-hairline);
  border-radius: var(--cn-r-control);
  background: var(--cn-secondary);
}
.trial-wait-line {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--cn-s-8);
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--v8-ink);
  font-size: var(--cn-fs-body);
  font-weight: 600;
}
.trial-wait-line b {
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  font-weight: 700;
}
.trial-wait-note,
.trial-wait-hint {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--v8-ink);
  font-size: var(--cn-fs-body);
  line-height: 1.45;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.trial-wait-hint {
  font-size: var(--cn-fs-caption);
}
.trial-wait-pulse {
  flex: none;
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--cn-accent);
}
@keyframes trial-wait-pulse {
  0%,
  100% {
    opacity: 0.35;
  }
  50% {
    opacity: 1;
  }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
  .trial-wait-pulse {
    animation: trial-wait-pulse 1.6s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
}
.trial-wait-outcome {
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--cn-s-8);
  margin: 0 0 var(--cn-s-12);
  padding: var(--cn-s-12) var(--cn-s-16);
  border-left: 3px solid var(--cn-accent);
  border-radius: var(--cn-r-control);
  background: var(--cn-secondary);
  color: var(--v8-ink);
  font-size: var(--cn-fs-body);
  line-height: 1.45;
}
.trial-wait-outcome strong {
  font-weight: 750;
}
.trial-wait-outcome span {
  color: var(--v8-ink);
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

/* Today's stay-search outcome: waiting, refused and empty are three different faces, and
   none of them is the ordinary Today. */
.hub-stay-searching,
.hub-stay-refused,
.hub-stay-empty {
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--cn-s-8);
  margin-top: var(--cn-s-12);
  padding: var(--cn-s-12) var(--cn-s-16);
  border-radius: var(--cn-r-control);
  background: var(--cn-secondary);
  color: var(--v8-ink);
  font-size: var(--cn-fs-body);
  line-height: 1.45;
}
.hub-stay-searching {

     place and #fff in two others — one token, three intents.  Accent and card
     surface get real values here; the near-black site was never a surface at all,
     it wanted the page canvas behind a fading sticky bar, so that declaration now
     reads --v8-canvas directly in styles.css.
     --v8-accent binds to the SOLID accent, not the text accent: it paints button
     fills that carry white labels (.v8-primary-button is shared by the create-trip
     CTA and Live's live-accept).  --cn-accent is tuned for text on the canvas and is
     #0a84ff under dark, which put white-on-blue at 3.4:1 and turned
     qoder-live-structure's L2 dark assertion red. */
  --v8-accent: var(--cn-accent-solid);
  --v8-surface: var(--cn-surface);
  /* Mobile chrome geometry in one place.  The shell used to reserve a hardcoded
     63px below the page, which was just a snapshot of "however tall the nav
     happened to be"; the nav itself carried no safe-area at all.  48 + 8 + 7 = 63
     is the arithmetic the old literal stood for, now written out. */
  --cn-touch-min: 44px;
  --cn-nav-bg: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95);
  --cn-nav-item-h: max(48px, var(--cn-touch-min));
  --cn-nav-pad-top: 8px;
  --cn-nav-pad-bottom: 7px;
  /* Measured, not derived. The old value was arithmetic -- item floor 48 + 8 + 7 = 63px -- while the
     bar renders **76px** at 390x844 (two independent measurements: e2e evidence
     `ui-overnight/nav-reservation.json`, and commander `raw/nav_clearance.json`). The extra ~12px is
     content: icon + label + `gap: 4px` exceed the 48px floor, and `min-height` is a floor, not a
     cap. `--cn-nav-clearance` below feeds `.v8-product-shell { padding-bottom }`, which every page
     inherits, so the short number put the last 13px of any phone screen under the nav.
     80 = 76 measured + 4 of margin. If the nav's content grows, this grows with it, and the gate
     `nav-reservation-covers-the-rendered-bar` goes red when it does not. */
  --cn-nav-h: 80px;
  --cn-nav-clearance: calc(var(--cn-nav-h) + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
  --cn-safe-top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px);
}

.v8-product-shell {
  font-family: var(--cn-font);
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
}

/* Typography rhythm on the surfaces the app already renders. */
.v8-page { background: var(--cn-canvas); }
.v8-page h1, .v8-hero-title { font-size: var(--cn-fs-display); font-weight: 700; line-height: var(--cn-lh-tight); letter-spacing: -0.02em; }
.v8-page h2, .v8-section-title { font-size: var(--cn-fs-title); font-weight: 700; line-height: var(--cn-lh-tight); letter-spacing: -0.015em; }

/* Unify card material: solid content, restrained depth (no atmosphere floating). */
.v8-page .v8-card,
.v8-page .replan-card,
.v8-page .evidence-card,
.v8-page .map-card {
  background: var(--cn-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--cn-hairline);
  border-radius: var(--cn-r-card);
  box-shadow: var(--cn-shadow-card);
}

/* --- Motion: transform/opacity only, GPU-friendly, capped, reduced-motion aware --- */

@keyframes cn-rise {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translate3d(0, 10px, 0); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0); }
}

/* One orchestrated page-load reveal; sections stagger by <=40ms, max 4 groups. */
.v8-page { animation: cn-rise var(--cn-t-reveal) var(--cn-ease-out) both; }
.v8-page > * { animation: cn-rise var(--cn-t-reveal) var(--cn-ease-out) both; }
.v8-page > *:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: 0ms; }
.v8-page > *:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 28ms; }
.v8-page > *:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 56ms; }
.v8-page > *:nth-child(4),
.v8-page > *:nth-child(n + 5) { animation-delay: 84ms; } /* capped: no DOM parade */

/* Restrained press + hover feedback (transform only, no rotate / big shadow). */
.v8-page button:not(.cn-no-motion):active,
.v8-page [role="button"]:active,
.v8-page a.v8-cta:active { transform: scale(0.985); transition: transform var(--cn-t-press) var(--cn-ease-standard); }
.v8-page button:not(.cn-no-motion),
.v8-page a.v8-cta,
.v8-page .v8-card { transition: transform var(--cn-t-hover) var(--cn-ease-standard), box-shadow var(--cn-t-hover) var(--cn-ease-standard); }
@media (hover: hover) {
  .v8-page .v8-card:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: var(--cn-shadow-raised); }
}

/* Focus-visible ring (keyboard), Apple-ish soft accent. */
.v8-page :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cn-accent); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: var(--cn-r-control); }

/* Touch targets >=44px on primary controls. */
.v8-page button, .v8-page a.v8-cta, .v8-nav button { min-height: 44px; }

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .v8-page,
  .v8-page > *,
  .v8-page button, .v8-page a.v8-cta, .v8-page .v8-card {
    animation: none !important;
    transition: none !important;
    transform: none !important;
    opacity: 1 !important;
  }
}

/* --- Today hierarchy refinement (GPT call #2): Hero -> Attention -> Timeline --- */
/* Single-focus Now/Next Hero (GPT pass-3). One reveal group, one primary CTA. */
.cn-now-next-hero {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--cn-s-8);
  padding: 24px;
  border: 1px solid var(--cn-hairline);
  border-radius: 20px;
  background: var(--cn-surface);
  box-shadow: var(--cn-shadow-card);
  min-height: 0;
}
.cn-now-next-hero .cn-hero-label {
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 2px;
  color: var(--cn-ink-tertiary);
  font-size: var(--cn-fs-caption);
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
.cn-hero-now .cn-hero-now-place {
  display: block;
  color: var(--cn-ink);
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: 650;
  line-height: 1.2;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.cn-hero-now {
  padding-bottom: var(--cn-s-8);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--cn-hairline);
}
.cn-hero-next-row {
  display: block;
  color: var(--cn-ink);
  font-size: var(--cn-fs-title);
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: var(--cn-lh-tight);
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.cn-hero-meta {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 4px;
  color: var(--cn-ink-secondary);
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: var(--cn-lh-body);
}
/* ORD-0082: this line says which clock chose Now/Next, so it is not decoration and does not get
   the secondary grey a caption would. */
.cn-clock-source {
  display: block;
  margin-top: var(--cn-s-8);
  color: var(--cn-ink);
  font-size: var(--cn-fs-caption);
  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: var(--cn-lh-body);
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.cn-hero-cta {
  align-self: start;
  margin-top: var(--cn-s-8);
  min-height: 50px;
}
/* The whole card reveals once; do not stagger its Now/Next/CTA children. */
.cn-now-next-hero.cn-hero-stagger > * { animation: none; }

/* Stay / anchors step down into a compact secondary strip beneath the hero. */
.cn-hero-strip {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: var(--cn-s-8) var(--cn-s-16);
  margin: 10px 0 0;
  padding: 12px 16px;
  border: 1px solid var(--cn-hairline);
  border-radius: var(--cn-r-card);
  background: var(--cn-secondary);
}
.cn-strip-item { display: grid; gap: 2px; min-width: 0; }
.cn-strip-item > span {
  color: var(--cn-ink-secondary);
  font-size: var(--cn-fs-caption);
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
.cn-strip-item > strong,
.cn-strip-item > b {
  color: var(--cn-ink);
  font-size: var(--cn-fs-secondary);
  font-weight: 600;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.cn-attention-band {
  margin: 14px 0 0;
  padding: var(--cn-s-16) var(--cn-s-20);
  border-radius: var(--cn-r-card);
  background: var(--cn-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--cn-hairline);
  box-shadow: var(--cn-shadow-card);
}
.cn-attention-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--cn-s-12);
}
.cn-attention-head .v8-kicker { margin: 0; }
.cn-attention-head strong {
  font-size: var(--cn-fs-card);
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
}
.cn-attention-head strong.warn { color: var(--cn-danger); }
.cn-attention-head strong.green { color: var(--cn-success); }
.cn-attention-hint {
  margin: 6px 0 0;
  color: var(--cn-ink-secondary);
  font-size: var(--cn-fs-secondary);
  line-height: var(--cn-lh-body);
}
.cn-attention-cta { margin-top: var(--cn-s-12); }

/* Handled history: a quiet single line, no card chrome. */
.cn-attention-band[data-attention="handled"] {
  padding: 6px 2px;
  background: transparent;
  border-color: transparent;
  box-shadow: none;
}
.cn-attention-band[data-attention="handled"] .cn-attention-head {
  align-items: center;
}
.cn-attention-band[data-attention="handled"] .cn-attention-head strong {
  font-size: var(--cn-fs-secondary);
}
.cn-attention-band[data-attention="handled"] .cn-attention-hint {
  display: inline;
  margin-left: 8px;
  font-size: var(--cn-fs-caption);
}
/* Nothing to attend: near-zero visual footprint — "无事就闭嘴". The element
   stays in the DOM (rendered tests look for it) but reads as a whisper, not an
   "all clear" monument. */
.cn-attention-band[data-attention="clear"] {
  padding: 2px;
  margin: 4px 0 0;
  background: transparent;
  border-color: transparent;
  box-shadow: none;
}
.cn-attention-band[data-attention="clear"] .cn-attention-head {
  justify-content: flex-start;
}
.cn-attention-band[data-attention="clear"] .v8-kicker {
  display: none;
}
.cn-attention-band[data-attention="clear"] .cn-attention-head strong {
  font-size: var(--cn-fs-caption);
  font-weight: 600;
}
/* Open attention escalates with a warm edge. */
.cn-attention-band[data-attention="open"] {
  border-color: rgba(215, 0, 21, 0.28);
}
@keyframes cn-attention-in {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translate3d(0, 8px, 0); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
}
.cn-attention-band[data-attention="open"] {
  animation: cn-attention-in var(--cn-t-reveal) var(--cn-ease-out) both;
}

/* --- Live replan motion — PRESENTATION ONLY (GPT call #3) ---
   A pure CSS response to the data-state attribute on the proposal card. This
   does not touch, and must never touch, what counts as accepted, when a
   disruption is resolved, or which proposal maps to which event — that logic
   survived six truth-gate versions and is out of scope for the design line. */
.v8-page .live-proposal {
  transition:
    opacity var(--cn-t-state) var(--cn-ease-standard),
    transform var(--cn-t-state) var(--cn-ease-standard);
}
.v8-page .live-proposal[data-state="accepting"] {
  opacity: 0.72;
  transform: translate3d(0, -2px, 0);
}
@keyframes cn-accept-settle {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translate3d(0, 8px, 0); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
}
.v8-page .live-handled,
.v8-page [data-testid="live-message"] {
  animation: cn-accept-settle var(--cn-t-accept) var(--cn-ease-out) both;
}

/* Live single-focus IA (GPT A+): the map is compact; when a decision is active
   it shrinks slightly so the disruption/replan rises toward the first screen. */
.live-shell { display: block; }
/* Live already shows the single current state; hide LiveRecovery's duplicate
   header (kept in the DOM) so the decision, not two titles, owns the fold. */
.live-shell > [data-testid="live-recovery"] > .v8-page-intro { display: none; }
.cn-live-secondary {
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--cn-s-12);
  margin-top: var(--cn-s-8);
  padding-top: var(--cn-s-12);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--cn-hairline);
}
.cn-live-secondary .v8-mode-chooser { box-shadow: none; }
.cn-live-secondary .v8-live-side { gap: var(--cn-s-8); }
.cn-live-secondary .v8-next-card,
.cn-live-secondary .v8-comparison { box-shadow: none; }
/* Decision-active emphasis is expressed through layout order + the separator
   above (not opacity, which the contrast audit cannot see). */

@media (max-width: 680px) {
  .live-shell > .v8-page .v8-live-main > .v8-map-panel {
    min-height: 240px !important;
    height: 240px !important;
    box-sizing: border-box !important;
  }
  .live-shell[data-decision-active="true"] > .v8-page .v8-live-main > .v8-map-panel {
    min-height: 208px !important;
    height: 208px !important;
  }
  /* Ruling #4, take two. The 240/208 sizing above is stated with !important so
     it beats the shell's own media rules — which also meant it silently beat my
     first empty-state fix (computed min-height stayed 240px against a
     max-height of 156px, because min-height wins over max-height in CSS). An
     honest empty state has to be exempted in the same register it was sized. */
  .live-shell > .v8-page .v8-live-main > .v8-map-panel.v8-map-empty {
    min-height: 0 !important;
    height: auto !important;
    max-height: 156px;
  }
}

/*
 * Controlled dark-mode convergence, driven by e2e/qoder-dark-audit.spec.ts
 * (GPT final call #1). NOT a blind 114-colour rewrite: the audit swept the
 * reachable Today (/v8/hub) and Live (/v8/live) surfaces under emulated dark
 * and reported exactly these classes. Most are SHELL surfaces that live outside
 * `.v8-page` (topbar, mobile nav, copilot pill, avatar, language button) — the
 * gap a `.v8-page`-scoped pass could not reach. Each is rebound to a theme
 * token so light stays as-is and dark follows, and filled controls use
 * --cn-accent-solid so white labels clear AA. Legacy / Advanced / Wallet-JSON /
 * off-path panels are intentionally left as declared debt this pass.
 */

  /* 1. Shell surfaces that painted a hardcoded white in dark. */
  :root[data-theme="dark"] .v8-product-shell .v8-topbar {
    background: var(--cn-surface) !important;

  :root[data-theme="dark"] .v8-product-shell .v8-breadcrumb, :root[data-theme="dark"] .v8-product-shell .v8-runtime, :root[data-theme="dark"] .v8-product-shell .v8-icon-button {
    color: var(--cn-ink-secondary) !important;

  :root[data-theme="dark"] .v8-product-shell .v8-breadcrumb strong { color: var(--cn-ink) !important; }
  :root[data-theme="dark"] .v8-product-shell .v8-mobile-nav {
    background: rgba(28, 28, 30, 0.92) !important;

  }
  :root[data-theme="dark"] .v8-product-shell .v8-mobile-nav button { color: var(--cn-ink-secondary) !important; }
  :root[data-theme="dark"] .v8-product-shell .v8-mobile-nav button.active { color: var(--cn-accent) !important; }
  :root[data-theme="dark"] .v8-product-shell .cn-copilot-edge {

  /* 2. Language button: was white fill + bright accent text. */
  :root[data-theme="dark"] .v8-product-shell .v9-language, :root[data-theme="dark"] .v8-page .v9-language {
    background: var(--cn-secondary) !important;
    color: var(--cn-ink) !important;
    border-color: var(--cn-control-border) !important;
  }

  /* 3. Filled controls: deep accent so the white label clears AA in dark. */
  :root[data-theme="dark"] .v8-product-shell .v8-avatar, :root[data-theme="dark"] .v8-product-shell .v8-primary, :root[data-theme="dark"] .v8-product-shell .cn-copilot-edge-mark, :root[data-theme="dark"] .v8-product-shell .v9-navigate, :root[data-theme="dark"] .v8-product-shell a.v9-navigate {
    background: var(--cn-accent-solid) !important;

  /* 4. Content cards / rows that kept a light fill inside .v8-page. */
  :root[data-theme="dark"] .v8-page .v8-day-card, :root[data-theme="dark"] .v8-page .v8-day-detail, :root[data-theme="dark"] .v8-page .v8-live-now, :root[data-theme="dark"] .v8-page .v8-mode-chooser, :root[data-theme="dark"] .v8-page .v8-next-card, :root[data-theme="dark"] .v8-page .v8-comparison, :root[data-theme="dark"] .v8-page .v8-outline-button, :root[data-theme="dark"] .v8-page .v8-compare-button, :root[data-theme="dark"] .v8-page .v8-rain-button, :root[data-theme="dark"] .v8-page .v8-map-panel {
    background: var(--cn-surface) !important;

  }
  /* Outline buttons carry no fill — their border is the only affordance, so it

  :root[data-theme="dark"] .v8-page .active, :root[data-theme="dark"] .v8-page .v8-mode-chooser .active {

  }
  :root[data-theme="dark"] .v8-page .v8-map-caption {

  }
  :root[data-theme="dark"] .v8-page .v8-status-pill {

  }
  :root[data-theme="dark"] .v8-page .mode-mark {
    /* Was accent text on a grey fill: 3.82:1 at 8px/800, below AA.  A filled accent chip

    color: var(--cn-canvas) !important;

  /* 5. Hardcoded grey-blue body text that fell below AA on the dark canvas. */
  :root[data-theme="dark"] .v8-product-shell .v8-lede, :root[data-theme="dark"] .v8-product-shell .v8-muted, :root[data-theme="dark"] .v8-product-shell .v8-live-now p, :root[data-theme="dark"] .v8-product-shell .v8-live-now > strong, :root[data-theme="dark"] .v8-product-shell .v8-mode-chooser span, :root[data-theme="dark"] .v8-product-shell .v8-mode-chips button, :root[data-theme="dark"] .v8-product-shell .v8-next-card p, :root[data-theme="dark"] .v8-product-shell .v8-eta span, :root[data-theme="dark"] .v8-product-shell .v9-evidence-summary > small {
    color: var(--cn-ink-secondary) !important;
  }
  :root[data-theme="dark"] .v8-product-shell .v8-live-label { color: var(--cn-danger) !important; }
  :root[data-theme="dark"] .v8-product-shell .v8-live-label .status-dot { background: var(--cn-danger) !important; }

  :root[data-theme="dark"] .v8-page button:not([class]) {
    background: var(--cn-surface);
    color: var(--cn-ink);
    border: 1px solid var(--cn-hairline);
  }


/*
 * Desktop-only sidebar (renders above 680px, so only the desktop audit reaches

 */

  :root[data-theme="dark"] .v8-product-shell .v8-sidebar {

  :root[data-theme="dark"] .v8-page .live-disruption {

  :root[data-theme="dark"] .v8-page .live-proposal {
    background: var(--cn-surface) !important;
    border-color: var(--cn-hairline) !important;
    color: var(--cn-ink) !important;
  }
  :root[data-theme="dark"] .v8-page .live-disruption b, :root[data-theme="dark"] .v8-page .live-proposal b { color: var(--cn-ink) !important; }
  :root[data-theme="dark"] .v8-page .live-summary, :root[data-theme="dark"] .v8-page .live-unchanged, :root[data-theme="dark"] .v8-page .live-diff { color: var(--cn-ink-secondary) !important; }
  :root[data-theme="dark"] .v8-page .role-alert { color: #ff6961 !important; }
  :root[data-theme="dark"] .v8-page .live-handled { color: #7bd88f !important; }

  /* Mode chips: the reorder lifted them into the desktop viewport, exposing a
     hard-coded #fff fill (a light surface in dark) and a selected state that was
     indistinguishable from unselected. Unselected = surface + control-border
     (unfilled control); selected = accent-solid fill + white label (a real
     fill-difference cue, not colour alone). */
  :root[data-theme="dark"] .v8-page .v8-mode-chips button {
    background: var(--cn-surface) !important;
    color: var(--cn-ink-secondary) !important;
    border-color: var(--cn-control-border) !important;
  }
  :root[data-theme="dark"] .v8-page .v8-mode-chips button.active {
    background: var(--cn-accent-solid) !important;
    color: #fff !important;
    border-color: transparent !important;
  }


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   AA-safe eyebrow text (regression fix found by axe in the real-seed
   integration run, 2026-09-19). `.v8-kicker` inherits --v8-indigo, which the
   Apple palette binds to --cn-accent — fine as a link, 4.42:1 as 10px text on
   the light canvas. Page intros get the dedicated --cn-accent-text instead.
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.v8-page-intro .v8-kicker { color: var(--cn-accent-text); }

/* An outline button has no fill, so its border is the only affordance — under
   the light theme it was still the legacy hardcoded #d9ddea (1.2:1 on white),
   the same failure the dark pass fixed with --cn-control-border. Fixed on both
   sides of the theme now, decorative separators untouched. */
.v8-page .v8-outline-button { border-color: var(--cn-control-border); }

/* Hero eyebrow labels: --cn-ink-tertiary is 3.33:1 on the canvas, which fails
   AA for 10-11px caption text. Secondary ink clears it (4.66:1) and stays
   visually subordinate to the stop name beneath it. */
.cn-now-next-hero .cn-hero-label { color: var(--cn-ink-secondary); }

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Shell chrome tokenised for the light theme (found the moment the two-theme
   contrast gate was switched on). These greys were hardcoded in styles.css at
   1.5–3.9:1 on white: breadcrumb text and its "/" separator, the workspace
   label, the sidebar nav group captions, the nav buttons and the language
   toggle's outline. Under dark they were pulled in by the theme binding; under
   light they were simply too faint, and axe/computed-style agree.
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.v8-breadcrumb,
.v8-breadcrumb b,
.v8-workspace-label,
.v8-nav-group,
.v8-nav button,
.v8-runtime {
  color: var(--cn-ink-secondary);
}
.v8-nav button.active,
.v8-nav button:hover,
.v8-page .v9-language {
  color: var(--cn-ink);
}
.v9-language,
.v8-home-language {
  border-color: var(--cn-control-border);
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Accent-as-text and remaining sidebar chrome (light theme).
   Rebinding --v8-indigo to Apple blue made every text consumer of it — the
   kicker outside page intros, quiet/text buttons — drop to 4.43:1 on the
   #f5f5f7 canvas. They now take --cn-accent-text, which is the same hue at an
   AA-safe depth. The sidebar tagline, the sync panel, the icon button and the
   mode chips were legacy hardcoded greys/blues that the light theme had never
   been checked against.
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.v8-kicker,
.v8-text-button,
.v8-quiet-button,
.v8-compare-button {
  color: var(--cn-accent-text);
}
.v8-brand span,
.v8-sync div,
.v8-icon-button {
  color: var(--cn-ink-secondary);
}
/* 4.40:1 as #248a3d on the tinted sync panel; the deeper green reads identical
   but clears AA for 11px bold text. */
.v8-sync {
  color: #17672f;
}
/* A mode chip's border is its selection affordance, so it must clear 3:1. */
button[data-testid^="mode-"],
.v8-mode-option {
  border-color: var(--cn-control-border);
}

/* The "all clear" caption is the only text in the collapsed attention band; it
   inherits the semantic green, which as small text needed the AA-safe variant.
   "无事就闭嘴" must not mean "say it too faintly to read". */
.cn-attention-band[data-attention="clear"] .cn-attention-head strong {
  color: var(--cn-success-text);
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Focus ring (light theme). The shell's own rule paints a 3px #9aa8ff outline,
   which measures 2.05-2.23:1 against the #f5f5f7 canvas. Dark was fine; light
   had never been measured because this gate used to emulate dark only.
   --cn-accent-text is 5.49:1 on the canvas, and its dark twin #0a84ff is
   5.76:1 on the dark canvas, so one token now serves both schemes.
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
:focus-visible,
.v8-product-shell :focus-visible,
.v8-product-shell button:focus-visible,
.v8-product-shell [role="button"]:focus-visible,
.v8-product-shell textarea:focus-visible {
  outline-color: var(--cn-accent-text);
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Today secondary action row (pass-8 ruling #1/#2).
   These three utilities used to render as four stacked full-width buttons with
   no shared layout rule at all (.v8-hub-actions had no CSS in the repo), which
   is how the hero's single primary action got out-shouted on a real journey.
   They are now one quiet, wrapping text row under the trip summary.
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.v8-hub-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 2px 16px;
  margin-top: 10px;
}
/* 30px = compact fine-pointer visual density; mobile/touch hit target is superseded
   by the >=44px accessibility contract.  (Amendment F-2.)  The override below uses the
   same 0,2,0 selector on purpose: styles.css's 0,1,0 floor cannot outrank this rule,
   so the mobile contract has to be asserted at this specificity. */
.v8-hub-actions .v8-quiet-button {
  min-height: 30px;
  padding: 2px 0;
  font-size: var(--cn-fs-caption);
  font-weight: 600;
}
@media (max-width: 680px) {
  .v8-hub-actions .v8-quiet-button { min-height: var(--cn-touch-min); }
}
/* A border-left separator looked wrong here: these buttons inherit a
   border-radius, so the 1px edge drew an arc. A typographic middot keeps the
   row quiet without painting a box. */
.v8-hub-actions .v8-quiet-button + .v8-quiet-button::before {
  content: "·";
  margin-right: 16px;
  color: var(--cn-ink-tertiary);
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Live toolbar + honest empty-map height (pass-8 ruling #3/#4).
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.cn-live-toolbar {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 2px 16px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}
/* 30px = compact fine-pointer visual density; mobile/touch hit target is superseded
   by the >=44px accessibility contract.  (Amendment F-2.) */
.cn-live-toolbar .v8-quiet-button {
  min-height: 30px;
  padding: 2px 0;
  font-size: var(--cn-fs-caption);
  font-weight: 600;
}
@media (max-width: 680px) {
  .cn-live-toolbar .v8-quiet-button { min-height: var(--cn-touch-min); }
}
.cn-live-toolbar .v8-quiet-button + .v8-quiet-button::before {
  content: "·";
  margin-right: 16px;
  color: var(--cn-ink-tertiary);
}

/* The 240/208 map-height rule governs a *rendered* map. With no trustworthy
   coordinates the panel still reserved a map-sized box, so a two-line caption
   sat inside roughly 400px of empty card and pushed the actual journey state
   below the fold. An honest empty state should cost an honest empty-state
   height. */
.v8-page .v8-map-panel.v8-map-empty {
  min-height: 0;
  max-height: 156px;
  padding: 14px 16px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
}
.v8-page .v8-map-empty .v8-map-empty-body p {
  margin: 4px 0 0;
  font-size: var(--cn-fs-caption);
  line-height: 1.45;
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Pass-8 ruling #5 — one bottom clearance, and a dock that yields in full.
   The dock is a fixed overlay, so "does it cover the primary action" used to
   depend on where the page happened to be scrolled. Two changes:
   * every page reserves a bottom band for the dock + mobile nav, so content is
     never the thing that has to dodge it;
   * when a surface is already on screen (yield-to-surface), the dock collapses
     to a right-aligned pill instead of a 230px slab that still spans the width
     of a full-bleed Accept button.
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* Reserve the band once, on the scrolling content container. Putting it on
   .v8-page was wrong: Today/Live render several .v8-page sections in a row, so
   each one added the clearance and pushed the decision 124px further down per
   section — the gate caught it as an 8px first-screen miss. */
.v8-content {
  padding-bottom: calc(124px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
}
.cn-copilot-dock.yield-to-surface {
  right: 10px;
  left: auto;
  width: auto;
}
.cn-copilot-dock.yield-to-surface .cn-copilot-edge {
  width: auto;
  min-height: 42px;
  padding: 0 12px;
  font-size: 11px;
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Pass-8 ruling #6/#7 (mainline chrome, done here because the visual gate is
   what found them).
   #7a - the budget line and its explanatory hint are two inline spans with no
         separator, which rendered as "每人每天约 ¥500这是按你的预算…".
   #7b - the Live leg line interpolated the raw provider enum, so a Chinese
         sentence contained "transit"; every other mode surface uses modeLabel.
   #6  - the avatar is a 28px circle holding up to two initials; without a
         nowrap/overflow guard the glyphs sat on top of the circle's edge.
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.today-advisory strong {
  display: block;
}
.today-advisory span {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 3px;
  line-height: 1.45;
}
.v8-avatar {
  overflow: hidden;
  white-space: nowrap;
  flex: none;
  font-size: 9px;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}


/* The real seeded journey renders actual map markers for the first time (the
   demo/reset trip has no located activities), and the audit immediately caught
   the current-location badge: white 10px bold text on #d65e56 is 3.75:1 against
   a 4.5:1 requirement. "Current" is a location, not a risk, so it takes the
   accent fill rather than a deepened red, which also stops it reading the same
   as .disrupted. --cn-accent-solid (#0a66ff in both schemes) is the one the
   token set already defines for white label text at 4.82:1; the brighter link
   accent fails in dark at 3.49:1. */
.v9-map-marker.current {
  background: var(--cn-accent-solid);
}


/* Today's day cards only became auditable once the seed produced a real
   multi-day plan (the demo/reset trip has one day and no located activities).
   Two hardcoded greys fail AA as body text: .v8-day-card p at #6c7889 is
   4.48:1 on white and 3.8:1 on the dark surface, and the DAY n / meta row at
   #9aa4b3 is 2.52:1. Both take the ink-secondary token, which clears 4.5:1 in
   either scheme while staying visually subordinate to the stop name. */
.v8-day-card p,
.v8-day-card span,
.v8-day-card small,
.v8-day-detail-title small {
  color: var(--cn-ink-secondary);
}


/* Pass-9 blocker #2 — the idle dock presents as the same right-aligned pill the
   decision state already proved sufficient, so it stops covering Today's
   content while remaining one tap from the assistant. */
.cn-copilot-dock.idle-compact {
  right: 10px;
  left: auto;
  width: auto;
}
/* Pass-13.1: a position:fixed accessory sits wherever the page happens to come
   to rest, and pass-13 measured this one resting on top of the DAY 1 card
   (158x54 of tappable surface).  Reserving that band properly would cost a phone
   ~138px of every screen, so the pill yields instead: when something actionable
   is under it at rest, it steps off the content column and comes back when the
   band clears.  The bottom navigation keeps its own Copilot entry, so the
   assistant is never further away than one tab.  The decision is made against
   the pill's layout box, so this transform cannot make it oscillate. */
.cn-copilot-dock.idle-compact.yield-at-rest {
  /* visibility, not just opacity: an invisible-but-focusable pill is a ghost
     button — a keyboard traveller can land on a control nobody can see, and the
     accessibility tree keeps advertising it as an available action.  Hidden
     visibility takes it out of both, and returns it when the band clears. */
  transform: translateX(calc(100% + 16px));
  opacity: 0;
  visibility: hidden;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: transform 140ms ease, opacity 140ms ease, visibility 140ms linear;
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .cn-copilot-dock.idle-compact.yield-at-rest { transition: none; }
}
.cn-copilot-dock.idle-compact .cn-copilot-edge {
  width: auto;
  min-height: 42px;
  padding: 0 12px;
  font-size: 11px;
}


/* The Live "现在 / Now" badge sits in a flex row and was being squeezed into two
   lines at 412px. It is a two-character tag: it must never wrap, and it must not
   be allowed to shrink. (Note for whoever reads the history: the first attempt at
   this rule silently no-oped because its existence check matched the dark-theme
   colour rule instead of itself.) */
.v8-live-label {
  flex: none;
  white-space: nowrap;
}


/* ===========================================================================
   Pass-17 UI overnight lane — the screen that renders outside the shell.

   JourneyTrialSetup is returned at V8Experience.tsx:818, before
   .v8-product-shell exists.  Everything the shell supplied was therefore
   missing on the very first screen a traveller sees:
     * the --v8-* tokens            (fixed by hoisting the bindings to :root)
     * a text colour                (body never set one; only the shell did)
     * the horizontal gutter        (.v8-content owns it, and there is no .v8-content)
     * the status-bar inset         (viewport-fit=cover makes env() real)

   Amendment F-1 ruled that this screen is *deliberately* outside the app chrome — an
   onboarding flow should carry one navigation (Back / Next / Create), not that plus a
   bottom tab bar leading to destinations that are empty or misleading before a journey
   exists.  So the fix is not a structural shell migration: it is separating the visual
   foundation from the navigation chrome.  body keeps a real declaration because a
   document root should state its own colours, and .cn-onboarding then states the rest
   explicitly.  The earlier generic `.v8-page { padding: … }` plus
   `.v8-content .v8-page { padding: 0 }` pair is removed: that was the "it inherits
   because it happens to sit in the shell's class" pattern F-1 rejects.
   =========================================================================== */
body {
  color: var(--v8-ink);
  background: var(--v8-canvas);
  font-family: var(--cn-font);
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
}
/* The onboarding surface's own foundation — declared, not inherited by accident.
   It intentionally renders no .v8-mobile-nav.

   ORD-0338 (甲): it is a two-row app pane -- row 1 is the only thing that scrolls, row 2 is
   the CTA band.  Until now the band was `position: sticky`, so it painted over whatever
   happened to be under it and the content had to keep a reserve of padding away from it; that
   reserve (76px + the stage clearance, 212px measured) is the blank band ORD-0338 was opened
   for, and it was load-bearing for ORD-0261/0264.  A layout row cannot be painted over, so the
   reserve has nothing to protect and both ends of that dependency are gone.
   `--vv-height` is published by `installVisualViewportVars()` (V8Experience.tsx:811, which runs
   on this surface too); the `100dvh` fallback is what a browser without a visual viewport gets. */
.cn-onboarding {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-rows: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  height: var(--vv-height, 100dvh);
  max-width: 1370px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: calc(var(--cn-s-32) + var(--cn-safe-top)) 0 0;
  /* One inset table for the pane's two rows: the scroller and the CTA band line up because they
     read the same inherited property, not because two media queries repeat a number. */
  --cn-onboarding-inset: var(--cn-gutter);
  background: var(--v8-canvas);
  color: var(--v8-ink);
  font-family: var(--cn-font);
}
@media (min-width: 961px) {
  .cn-onboarding { --cn-onboarding-inset: 46px; }
}
@media (max-width: 960px) and (min-width: 681px) {
  .cn-onboarding { --cn-onboarding-inset: 26px; }
}
/* The scroller.  `min-height: 0` is what lets a grid row scroll instead of pushing the pane
   taller than the viewport; `overscroll-behavior: contain` stops a flick at the end of the
   wizard from dragging the document behind it.  The horizontal inset lives here rather than on
   the section so the whole width of the pane answers to a thumb -- an inset on the section would
   leave two dead gutters that scroll nothing.  The top inset stays on the section, because that
   band is the notch and content must not scroll into it. */
.cn-onboarding__scroll {
  min-height: 0;
  overflow-y: auto;
  overscroll-behavior: contain;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
  padding: 0 var(--cn-onboarding-inset);
}

/* Three step labels cannot share 360px, and the ellipsis was eating
   "Travellers & preferences" at all three acceptance widths.  Progressive
   disclosure instead: the step you are on names itself, the others collapse to
   their number.  Visually-hidden rather than display:none — ORD-0014 A requires
   the fix not cost semantics, and display:none would drop the step name out of the
   accessibility tree, leaving a screen reader with a bare digit. */
@media (max-width: 680px) {
  .trial-steps { gap: var(--cn-s-8); }
  .trial-steps li { flex: 0 0 auto; position: relative; }
  .trial-steps li:not(.active) span:last-child {
    position: absolute;
    width: 1px;
    height: 1px;
    margin: -1px;
    padding: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    clip-path: inset(50%);
    white-space: nowrap;
    border: 0;
  }
}

/* Form fields were UA-white: a white slab floating on a dark card, and a
   black-on-black label wherever the page carried no inherited colour. */
.trial-field input,
.trial-field textarea,
.trial-field select {
  min-height: 34px; /* fine-pointer compact density; mobile/touch takes the >=44px contract below */
  padding: 0 var(--cn-s-12);
  border: 1px solid var(--cn-control-border);
  border-radius: var(--cn-r-control);
  background: var(--v8-panel);
  color: var(--v8-ink);
  font: inherit;
}
@media (max-width: 680px) {
  .trial-field input,
  .trial-field select { min-height: var(--cn-touch-min); }
}
.trial-field textarea { padding: var(--cn-s-12); }
.trial-field input::placeholder,
.trial-field textarea::placeholder { color: var(--cn-ink-tertiary); }
/* Native date pickers paint their own chrome; without this they stay light. */
.trial-field input[type="datetime-local"] { color-scheme: light dark; }

/* ORD-0034 — the onboarding failure notice.
   Text is --v8-ink on --cn-secondary in both themes (#1d1d1f on #f2f2f7 light,
   #f5f5f7 on #2c2c2e dark), because a semantic colour used as small text is exactly
   what fails AA; the danger hue is carried by the rule on the left, which is
   decorative and not the only carrier of meaning. */
.trial-create-error {
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--cn-s-8);
  margin: 0 0 var(--cn-s-8);
  padding: var(--cn-s-12) var(--cn-s-16);
  border-left: 3px solid var(--cn-danger);
  border-radius: var(--cn-r-control);
  background: var(--cn-secondary);
  color: var(--v8-ink);
  font-size: var(--cn-fs-body);
  line-height: 1.45;
}
.trial-create-error strong { font-weight: 750; }
/* ORD-0353: the measured fields fold.  Wrapped rather than scrolled so a long content-type cannot
   push the confirm button out of reach on a 390px screen, and no colour is set here -- the block
   inherits the alert's own ink, so the dark gate's contrast ruling is not re-opened by a new pair. */
.trial-technical { font-size: var(--cn-fs-body); }
.trial-technical summary { cursor: pointer; }
.trial-technical .cnx-raw-facts { display: grid; gap: var(--cn-s-8); }
.trial-technical .cnx-raw-facts-reading {
  margin: 0;
  white-space: pre-wrap;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.trial-technical-none,
.trial-technical .cnx-raw-facts-receipt { overflow-wrap: anywhere; }/* The named reason is the whole point of this panel, and it inherited --v8-muted, which
   styles.css overrides theme-blind -- the same hole ORD-0035 recorded. Full ink; size and
   the leading rule carry the hierarchy instead of a grey that may not be readable. */
.trial-create-error span { color: var(--v8-ink); overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

.trial-required-hint {
  margin: 0 0 var(--cn-s-8);
  padding: var(--cn-s-8) var(--cn-s-12);
  border-left: 3px solid var(--cn-accent-text);
  border-radius: var(--cn-r-control);
  background: var(--cn-secondary);
  color: var(--v8-ink);
  font-size: var(--cn-fs-body);
  line-height: 1.45;
}
/* The backend's own sentence, shown under the field it is about. Full ink in both themes:
   a rejection explanation cannot be the weakest text on the screen. */
.trial-field-problem {
  margin-top: var(--cn-s-4);
  color: var(--v8-ink);
  font-size: var(--cn-fs-caption);
  line-height: 1.4;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

/* ORD-0060 — an assumption the product is about to make has to be readable, not hinted at
   by a colour. The sentence says "没认出 / not recognised", so the rule is decoration. */
.trial-city-warning {
  margin: var(--cn-s-8) 0;
  padding: var(--cn-s-12) var(--cn-s-16);
  border-left: 3px solid var(--cn-danger);
  border-radius: var(--cn-r-control);
  background: var(--cn-secondary);
  color: var(--v8-ink);
  font-size: var(--cn-fs-body);
  line-height: 1.45;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
dd.trial-city-warning {
  margin: var(--cn-s-4) 0 0;
  padding: var(--cn-s-8) var(--cn-s-12);
  font-size: var(--cn-fs-caption);
}
.trial-supported {
  margin: 0 0 var(--cn-s-12);
  color: var(--v8-ink);
  font-size: var(--cn-fs-caption);
}
.trial-supported summary {
  /* Reachable with a thumb on the smallest layout without stealing weight from the CTA. */
  min-height: 30px;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  color: var(--v8-accent);
  font-weight: 700;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.trial-supported-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: var(--cn-s-4) var(--cn-s-12);
  margin: var(--cn-s-8) 0 0;
  padding-left: var(--cn-s-20);
  columns: 2;
  list-style: disc;
}

/* ORD-0346 — the panel groups by what the server answered, so a row is a sentence now and not a
   name in a two-column flow.  Every line of it carries meaning, so all of it is full ink:
   --v8-muted is overridden theme-blind in styles.css, which is the hole ORD-0035 recorded. */
.trial-supported-group {
  margin-top: var(--cn-s-12);
}
.trial-supported-group-title {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--v8-ink);
  font-size: var(--cn-fs-secondary);
  font-weight: 750;
  line-height: var(--cn-lh-body);
}
.trial-supported-group-rule {
  margin: 2px 0 0;
  color: var(--v8-ink);
  font-size: var(--cn-fs-caption);
  line-height: 1.4;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.trial-supported-none {
  margin: var(--cn-s-8) 0 0;
  color: var(--v8-ink);
  font-size: var(--cn-fs-caption);
}
.trial-supported-group .trial-supported-list {
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--cn-s-8);
  padding-left: 0;
  columns: auto;
  list-style: none;
}
.trial-supported-row {
